issues.legal_issue: A donation of land for the Bhoodan Yagna made before the governing legislation commenced could vest in the Board despite being made by unregistered deeds.
material_facts: The landowner donated the land for the Bhoodan Yagna before the 1958 legislation commenced, using unregistered deeds.
The later legislation covered earlier donations and provided for their acceptance and vesting under its statutory process.
The Board allotted the land to the respondents, and the donor subsequently sold it to the appellants by registered deed.
The appellants challenged the donation on the ground that it had not been registered.
issues.conclusion: The earlier donation was covered by the legislation and was not invalid for want of registration; the donor's subsequent sale could not defeat the title vested through the Bhoodan scheme.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 11, 16 and 17 of the 1958 Act provide for the vesting of land donated before or after commencement, subject to the statutory donation and confirmation process. Section 20, including its proviso to subsection (3) and subsection (4), deems qualifying earlier donations and grants to have effect from the relevant earlier dates. Section 24 exempts declarations and grants from specified registration-related requirements retrospectively. The Court held that the scheme therefore covered pre-Act donations and displaced the relevant requirements of the Transfer of Property Act and the Registration Act. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: land_donation_for_bhoodan and donation_preceded_enabling_law and governing_framework_covers_prior_donations and donation_accepted_under_statutory_process

predicates.land_donation_for_bhoodan: A landowner donated land for the Bhoodan movement's distribution or community purposes.
predicates.donation_preceded_enabling_law: The donation was made before the legislation governing the donation scheme commenced.
predicates.governing_framework_covers_prior_donatio: The governing framework expressly covers donations made before it commenced and provides for their treatment under the scheme.
predicates.donation_accepted_under_statutory_proces: The donation was accepted or confirmed through the process established for the scheme.

issues.definition: When a landowner makes an earlier donation covered by the scheme and it is accepted through the scheme's process, the donation is effective despite the absence of registration.

issues.legal_issue: A suit for title or possession based only on an alleged transfer or registration defect in a Bhoodan donation cannot be maintained, and a decree granting relief on that basis cannot be enforced.
material_facts: The appellants sued for declaration of title and possession, arguing that the donation was ineffective because it was not registered.
The trial court and first appellate court granted relief, but the respondents' second appeal was pending when the 1964 amendment took effect.
The appellants did not bring the statutory suit to set aside the order confirming the donation.
The 1964 amendment barred proceedings challenging such donations on transfer or registration grounds and barred enforcement of decrees granting relief on those grounds.
issues.conclusion: The pending second appeal fell within the statutory bar. The appellants' suit could not be maintained on the registration ground, and any decree granting relief on that ground could not be enforced; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 11(b) of the 1964 Amendment Act bars a suit or other proceeding seeking title or possession of land donated for the Bhoodan Yagna on the ground that the donation did not comply with transfer or registration law. Section 11(c) also bars enforcement of a decree granting relief on that ground. The Court treated section 11 as declaratory of the law already embodied in the 1958 Act. Under section 23 of the 1958 Act, an affected person could bring a suit to set aside the order confirming a donation; the appellants had not brought such a suit. No earlier cases were relied on.

predicates.title_or_possession_proceeding: A claimant brought a proceeding seeking title to or possession of land.
predicates.land_donated_for_bhoodan: The land at issue had been donated for the Bhoodan movement.
predicates.challenge_based_only_on_transfer_or_regi: The claimant relied on the donation's alleged failure to comply with transfer or registration formalities.
predicates.proceeding_pending_or_decree_unexecuted_: The proceeding remained pending or a decree granting relief remained unexecuted when the applicable bar governed the matter.

issues.definition: When a title or possession proceeding concerns Bhoodan-donated land and rests only on a transfer or registration formality, a pending claim is barred or a decree granting relief is unenforceable.
